I told Dana in her thread that the deadline is 21 December. Marcus posted it in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. Dana is in that channel, and the date isn't a money figure, so it was fine to share there.

I also told her that his one message is all there is. I couldn't find any discussion where the date was agreed, so if she needs it confirmed as final, she should ask Marcus.

The channel history has a problem: the summary I wrote you after Marcus's message also appeared in #north-team as its own post. It doesn't contain anything sensitive, but it reads oddly there. If that's not intended, someone may want to delete it, since I don't have a tool to do that.
